name: Message Header 11
definition: Specifies the header data such as the identification and the creation date and time, specific to the message.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the sender, to unambiguously identify the message.|Usage: The sender has to make sure that MessageIdentification is unique for a pre-agreed period.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the message was created.

RequestType.name: Request Type
RequestType.definition: Specific actions to be executed through the request.

OriginalBusinessQuery.name: Original Business Query
OriginalBusinessQuery.definition: Unique identification of the original query message.
